Happiest birthday, Esha, my jaanu, my bestie, my soulmate. ❤️🎀 You are the kind of person I genuinely cannot imagine my life without. And I'm not even exaggerating, bhai. I don't think I could ever explain how much you mean to me. You've been a part of my life for more than 2 years, and you've seen so many versions of me. I guess those two years were very different for me, okay? I changed a lot. I met so many people who hurt me, people I thought would stay but eventually left. But one thing I've always noticed is that you never left me. We've had fights, bhai, some REALLY ugly fights. We've had moments when things weren't okay between us at all, but even then, we never gave up on each other. And I think that's what makes our bond so special. 🥹❤️

And let's talk about WHERE WE ACTUALLY MET. That stupid Instagram GC. 😭 We started talking, eventually went our separate ways, and then somehow found each other again. And honestly, I genuinely believe that was God's plan. Because imagine meeting someone again after three or four months of being apart, just because I randomly thought of joining that place. And there you were. It's crazy to think about how two people who once went their separate ways could find each other again like that. Bhai, it's literally a LOVE STORY. 😭💗 Just like those couples who separate and somehow find their way back to each other, except in our case, it's the two of us. Before we separated, our bond was more like that of sisters. And when we met again, we slowly became even closer. First, good friends, then best friends, and now? Bhai, we're literally soulmates. 🫂💕

And you know what's funny? Even if there were a hundred other girls around us, we'd talk to them, get along with them, do everything, but I could never give anyone your place in my life. NEVER. You are my first priority (ALWAYS OK JAANU💋💋), my person, my constant. And honestly, I don't think I'll ever be able to love anyone the way I love you. I don't think I'll even love my future husband as much as I love you. 😭😭❤️ You're literally irreplaceable, Esha. My favourite human, my forever girl, my precious little blessing. I LOVE YOU SO MUCHHH. 🥹💗🧿

I start making excuses or trying to explain my side, saying things like, "No, but you were there and I was here," and then I think about it afterwards and realise that I could've handled things so much better. ♡ ♡ ♡

There's honestly so much I want to tell you, Esha, and sometimes I wish words were enough to explain everything I feel for you. I could write a thousand paragraphs, fill entire notebooks, and still feel like I haven't said enough. It's funny how one person can become such an important part of your everyday life without you even realising when it happened. One day you're just talking to someone, sharing random things, laughing at stupid jokes, and before you know it, that person becomes someone you cannot imagine a day without. That's exactly what happened with us. You slowly became a part of my routine, my happiness, my random thoughts, and practically every little thing I do. There are so many moments when something happens and my first thought is, "I HAVE TO TELL ESHA." 😭❤️ Because what's the point of experiencing something funny if I cannot come and tell you about it afterwards? You're literally the person I want to share my most random thoughts with, whether they're important or completely meaningless.

I hope you understand that you don't have to do anything extraordinary to make me happy. You don't have to buy me things, plan something special, or constantly prove that you care. Sometimes just receiving a random message from you is enough to make my day. Even the smallest conversations matter to me. I love hearing about your day, your problems, your achievements, the random things that happen around you, and even the most unnecessary gossip. 😭🎀 I want to know about the little things too. I want to know what made you laugh, what annoyed you, what made you excited, and what you've been thinking about lately. I don't want to be someone you only talk to when something important happens. I want to be someone you can randomly text at any hour just because you have something on your mind.

And please, never feel like you have to pretend to be happy around me. You can be completely yourself. You can be annoying, dramatic, emotional, angry, silly, quiet, or whatever version of yourself you feel like being that day. You don't have to filter your personality for me. I don't expect you to be perfect, and I certainly don't expect you to have everything figured out. We're both human, we're both going to make mistakes, and there will probably be countless moments when we don't understand each other. But I hope we always choose communication over assumptions. I hope we always talk things out instead of allowing unnecessary misunderstandings to grow. I want us to have the kind of friendship where neither of us is afraid to express how we feel. 🥹🫂

I also want you to know how proud I am of you. Maybe I don't say it enough, and maybe I don't always know how to express it, but I genuinely am. I'm proud of the person you are, the things you've experienced, and the way you continue moving forward. I know I don't know every single thought that goes through your mind, and I cannot possibly understand every struggle you've faced, but I hope you give yourself credit for how far you've come. Sometimes we become so busy noticing our flaws that we forget to appreciate ourselves. So please, be a little kinder to yourself. Celebrate your achievements, even the tiny ones. Don't underestimate yourself, and don't ever think you're not capable of achieving wonderful things. I genuinely want to see you succeed in everything you choose to do. ❤️

I hope you get opportunities that make you excited to wake up every morning. I hope you meet people who appreciate your personality, respect your boundaries, and recognise how valuable your presence is. I hope you never have to beg anyone for basic kindness or question whether you matter to them. You deserve friendships that feel comfortable, relationships that are respectful, and an environment where you can be yourself without constantly worrying about being judged. And whenever life gets confusing, I hope you remember that you have so much potential and so many beautiful experiences ahead of you. 🌷

You know what I find most interesting about our friendship? We didn't need to have everything in common to become this close. We have different backgrounds, different experiences, different perspectives, and probably completely different ways of looking at certain situations. Yet somehow, we understand each other in ways that are difficult to explain. I think that's one of the most beautiful things about friendship. It isn't always about finding someone exactly like yourself. Sometimes it's about finding someone whose presence makes you feel understood despite all your differences. And that's what I found in you. 💗

I want us to have so many more memories together. I want more random conversations that turn into hours of talking. More stupid jokes that make absolutely no sense to anyone else. More screenshots, more reels, more gossip, more late-night discussions, and more moments where we cannot stop laughing over something completely ridiculous. 😭 I want us to look back at our old conversations years from now and wonder how we managed to be so dramatic over the smallest things. I want us to remember the usernames, the people, the servers, the random arguments, and all those little details that might seem insignificant to everyone else but mean so much to us. 🥹

And someday, when we look back at these years, I hope we laugh about how everything started. Imagine telling someone that we met through a random Instagram group chat, went our separate ways, somehow found each other again, and eventually became this close. It sounds like something someone would write in a fictional story. But it's our story, and I wouldn't change the way we met for anything. Even the unexpected parts brought us here, and I'm grateful for every little coincidence that allowed our paths to cross again. 🧿❤️

I also hope you never feel that you have to compete with anyone for my attention or affection. Friendships aren't competitions, and having other people in my life doesn't make your friendship any less important. Everyone has their own place, but yours is special in its own way. I don't want us to measure our friendship by how many messages we exchange, how quickly we reply, or how much time we spend online. Life gets busy, circumstances change, and sometimes people have responsibilities that keep them occupied. But I hope we never mistake a busy day for a lack of love or care. What matters to me is that we continue choosing this friendship, respecting each other, and making an effort even when life becomes hectic.

If there's one thing I wish for us, it's that we never become strangers again. I know nobody can predict the future, and life doesn't always go according to our plans, but I genuinely hope we remain a part of each other's lives. I want to hear about your future achievements, your new experiences, your dreams, and all the exciting things that happen to you. I want to be there when you accomplish something you've worked hard for, and I want to celebrate even the smallest victories with you. I want to see you become the person you've always wanted to be, and I hope you allow me to share at least some of that journey with you. 🫂💕

Most importantly, I hope you never forget that your existence matters beyond what you do for other people. You don't have to constantly entertain everyone, make everyone happy, or be available all the time to deserve love. You're valuable simply because you're you. Your personality, your thoughts, your opinions, your humour, and all those little things that make you Esha are worth appreciating. Never let someone else's inability to recognise your worth make you question it.

And lastly, I want to thank you. THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING, MY GIRL. 😭❤️ Thank you for every conversation, every laugh, every silly argument, every random message, every memory, and every time you chose to stay. Thank you for being patient with me, for introducing me to new people, and for encouraging me to open up. Thank you for being part of so many moments that I'll probably remember for years. You might not realise how much of an impact you've had on my life, but I hope this letter gives you at least a small idea. I genuinely appreciate you, Esha, and I'm so glad that out of all the people I could have met, I got to meet YOU. I LOVE YOU SO MUCHHH, MY JAANU. 😭💗🎀🧿🫂
